main.summary: Implements stream transfer session operations with staged DataServices storage.

field.name: Coordinator
field.summary: Coordinates item and session locks for stream transfer operations.

field.name: Registry
field.summary: Resolves cross-family writer conflicts so source stream opens can reject conflicting segmented or stream writers.

field.name: Storage
field.summary: Provides append-oriented staged storage primitives for stream transfer sessions.

field.name: Options
field.summary: Configured transfer options used to clamp segment size policy and stage non-seekable payloads.

constructor.name: DataStreamTransferService
constructor.param: Cross-family transfer registry used to detect conflicting active or retained writer sessions.

method.name: ClampPolicy
method.summary: Clamp a requested segment size policy against the configured service defaults.
method.param: Configured service default segment size policy.
method.returns: Effective stream transfer segment size policy.

method.name: CreateOpenManifest
method.summary: Create the initial source stream transfer manifest for a new session.

method.name: CreateFollowerManifest
method.summary: Create the initial follower stream transfer manifest from the current source session state.

method.name: CreateRange
method.summary: Create a normalized transfer range value.

method.name: EnumerateStoredManifests
method.summary: Enumerate retained stream session manifests that satisfy the optional inspection filters.

method.name: FinalizeSourceManifest
method.summary: Create the finalized committed source manifest for a completed stream transfer session.

method.name: MatchesSessionFilter
method.summary: Determine whether a retained stream manifest matches the requested inspection filters.
method.returns: True when the manifest matches the requested filters.

method.name: LoadRequiredManifest
method.summary: Load and validate that a persisted stream transfer manifest exists for the given session and item identity.

method.name: ToServerSessionInfo
method.summary: Map a retained stream manifest to the server inspection record shape.
method.returns: Server inspection record for the retained stream session.

method.name: MapFailureCode
method.summary: Map a known stream transfer error message to its stream transfer failure code.

method.name: ReadRequiredCompletionStreamHash
method.summary: Compute the durable stream hash for the currently appended prefix of a source session.

method.name: SynchronizeFollowerManifest
method.summary: Refresh follower state from the current source manifest while preserving follower identity.

method.name: ValidateAbortRequest
method.summary: Validate a stream transfer abort request.

method.name: ValidateCompleteRequest
method.summary: Validate a stream transfer completion request.

method.name: ValidateFollowerReadable
method.summary: Validate that a source or follower manifest is readable for stream transfer operations.

method.name: ValidateHashBytes
method.summary: Validate that two hash payloads are equal.
method.param: Known error message to throw when validation fails.

method.name: ValidateHashPayloadAsync
method.summary: Validate the SHA-512 of a readable payload stream.
method.param: Known error message to throw when validation fails.

method.name: ValidateManifestIdentity
method.summary: Validate that a stream transfer manifest matches the expected session and item identity.

method.name: ValidateOpenFollowRequest
method.summary: Validate a stream follower open request.

method.name: ValidateOpenRequest
method.summary: Validate a stream source open request.

method.name: ValidateOptionalHashBytes
method.summary: Validate that an optional hash is either empty or the expected SHA-512 length.

method.name: ValidateReadRequest
method.summary: Validate a stream transfer segment read request.

method.name: ValidateReOpenFollowerRequest
method.summary: Validate a stream follower reopen request.

method.name: ValidateReOpenRequest
method.summary: Validate a stream source reopen request.

method.name: ValidateRemoveRequest
method.summary: Validate a stream transfer remove request.

method.name: ValidateSegmentHash
method.summary: Validate the SHA-512 of an appended stream segment.

method.name: ValidateSegmentLengthAgainstPolicy
method.summary: Validate a requested append length against the effective stream transfer segment size policy.

method.name: ValidateSourceReadable
method.summary: Validate that a source manifest is readable for stream transfer operations.

method.name: ValidateStateRequest
method.summary: Validate a stream transfer state request.

method.name: ValidateWritableSource
method.summary: Validate that a source stream transfer manifest remains writable for append or completion operations.

method.name: ValidateWriteRequest
method.summary: Validate a stream transfer append request.

main.summary: Provides a seekable temporary payload wrapper for non-seekable stream transfer append request bodies.

constructor.name: SeekablePayloadBuffer
constructor.summary: Create a temporary seekable payload wrapper.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Materialize a readable payload stream as a seekable stream when necessary.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Dispose the staged payload stream.
